label: noun-phrase complements: an adjective, a genitive phrase, a relative clause
note: Two thirds taught. The genitive is covered (MR-A1-POS-03) and the ADJECTIVE complement closed in chapter 49 (MR-A1-ADJ-01), so a noun can now carry a describing word. The relative clause is what remains, and it is blocked behind MR-A1-PRON-05: Marathi's relative is correlative, and no lesson supplies jo/tii/je.
